active_task: Migrated from GitHub Pages to Vercel for static deployment

architecture.scraper: GitHub Actions runs ./run.sh hourly (cron: '0 * * * *') → Phase 1 (scrape listings) → Phase 2 (enrich details) → Phase 3 (categorize) → commits data to repo
architecture.frontend: Fully static — loads enriched_jobs.json (~14MB, ~4000 jobs) directly in browser. All filtering, sorting, pagination, stats computed client-side. Notes saved to localStorage.
architecture.deployment: Vercel (free tier). Auto-deploys on push to main. Root directory = frontend/. No server.py needed.

current_state.server.py: Still works for local dev (python3 frontend/server.py), but NOT needed for deployment
current_state.repo: Can be private now (Vercel supports private repos on free tier)
